source: randomized controlled trial abstracts 2015 to 2024, PubMed E-utilities (2024) and Europe PMC (2015 to 2023), fetched 2026-10-26

gross.review: clear: month-6 counts 3/30 vs 2/30 and 0/30 vs 1/30 are printed with P = 0.008, and the verum arm is not lower

gross.review: clear: month-6 counts 3/30 vs 2/30 and 0/30 vs 1/30 are printed with P = 0.008, and the verum arm is not lower

gross.sentence: The assessments of the VR group in the positive rate of NYS [14.3% (5/35) vs 50.0% (18/36), P<0.001], ROM [48.6% (17/35) vs 55.6% (20/36), P<0.001], directional preponderance (DP) [34.3% (12/35) vs 75.0% (27/36), P<0.001] and DHI [26 (22, 32) vs 36 (30, 60), P=0.001] were significantly lower than that of the control group at 1 month after the treatment.
gross.review: ambiguous: the methods use a GEE model across visits

gross.sentence: During a 1-year follow-up, 8 of 45 patients who underwent EIVOM had recurrent atrial fibrillation, compared with 14 of 44 in the RFCA group (17.8% vs 31.8%; P < 0.01).
gross.review: clear: 8/45 vs 14/44 with P < 0.01; a time-to-event test on these counts would not reach that either

gross.sentence: In addition, patients with high electrographic flow consistency (EGFC) indicative of healthy or normal substrate had 67% (10 of 15) FFAF vs 45% (14 of 31) in those with low EGFC suggestive of abnormal substrate, P = .011.
gross.review: ambiguous: freedom from AF within a year is usually a Kaplan-Meier comparison

gross.sentence: SCH group also had significantly fewer participants with reduced menstrual volume [23 cases (12.6%, 23/182) vs 31 cases (17.5%, 31/177); P=0.038].
gross.review: ambiguous: menstrual volume likely has three ordered categories, so the P may cover all of them; the next sentence's chi-square P matches

gross.sentence: The randomized clinical trial consistently found less cumulative pain until POD 2 (NRS, 8/40 vs 14/40, P = 0.043), as well as until POD 10 (NRS, 22/190 vs 41/190, P = 0.010).
gross.review: ambiguous: the outcome is a pain score (NRS), so the counts may not be what was tested

gross.sentence: Two readers found no difference in the detection of patients with lesions (133/139 versus 135/139, P = .317; 137/139 versus 136/139, P = .564), while 1 reader found minimal differences in favor of gadoteridol (136/139 versus 132/139, P = .046).
gross.review: ambiguous: the same 139 patients are read twice, so a paired test applies

gross.sentence: Among intensivists offered an incentive, the response was 6.0% higher (95% CI 1.5-10.5, P=.01), survey completion was marginally greater (807/859, 94.0% vs 892/991, 90.0%; P=.06), and the median number of days to survey response was shorter (0.8, interquartile range [IQR] 0.2-14.4 vs 6.6, IQR 0.3-22.3; P=.001), with no difference in time spent completing the survey.
gross.review: clear: 807/859 vs 892/991 printed P = .06; every 2x2 test gives about .002

gross.sentence: Only the incidence of perianal excoriation was significantly higher in less than 3 months treatment group compared with more than 3 months treatment group [50.0%(9/18) vs. 23.5%(4/17), P=0.045].
gross.review: clear: 9/18 vs 4/17 printed P = 0.045; every 2x2 test gives over 0.1

gross.sentence: The occurrence of NNEI in the study group was significantly lower than that in the control group [17.02% (8/47) vs. 29.79% (14/47), X2 = 19.394, p = 0.004].
gross.review: clear: 8/47 vs 14/47 printed chi-square 19.394 and P = 0.004; the chi-square from these counts is about 1.9

gross.sentence: There were fewer any-grade toxicities in the PG versus placebo group (28/63 vs 33/64; P =.024).
gross.review: clear: 28/63 vs 33/64 printed P = .024; every 2x2 test gives about 0.4

gross.sentence: Irrespective of test order detrusor overactivity occurred significantly more often during the ice water test than during the warm water test (30 of 40 patients or 75% vs 25 of 40 or 63%, p = 0.02).
gross.review: ambiguous: the same 40 patients took both tests, so a paired test applies

gross.sentence: At 4 weeks, the median (IQR) change in UEMS in the RT group was 1/25 (0 to 3) points compared with 0/25 (-1 to 1) points in the OT group (p = 0.03).
gross.review: ambiguous: 1/25 is a median change in points, not a count

gross.sentence: Results: Overall, there was no significant difference between sham infants compared with MOM infants in mean postmenstrual age of full oral feeds (sham: 35 5/7 versus MOM 36 0/7; p = 0.37).
gross.review: ambiguous: 35 5/7 is a gestational age in weeks, not a count

gross.sentence: Overall, vasopressors were used in 10/75 patients in the etomidate group vs 21/75 in the propofol group (P=0.38), and in 20/74 patients during the blinded phase vs 11/76 during the open-label phase (P=0.31).
gross.review: clear: 10/75 vs 21/75 printed P = 0.38; Fisher gives 0.04

gross.sentence: Concerning satisfaction, there was a better global satisfaction rate in the WhatsApp group than in the control group (8/10 [interquartile range 8-9] vs 8/10 [interquartile range 8-8]; P=.049).
gross.review: ambiguous: 8/10 is a satisfaction score, not a count

gross.sentence: For patients in CT-ycN0, there was statistically significant difference in the sensitivity between CT-ycN stage and EUS-ycN stage (12.7%(7/55) vs . 5.5%(3/55); χ(2)=4.00, P= 0.046).
gross.review: ambiguous: both tests stage the same 55 patients, so a paired test applies, and McNemar can give the printed chi-square of 4.00

gross.sentence: The intervention did not significantly increase the number of THMs written on slides (77% (n = 20/26), 95% CI 56-91 vs 64% (n = 18/28), 95% CI 44-81, p = 0.31) nor THMs retention (13% (n = 238/1791), 95% CI 12-15 vs 17% (n = 326/1947), 95% 15-18, p = 0.40) nor knowledge (63.8 ± 26.2 vs 61.1 ± 31.4 /100 points, p = 0.75).
gross.review: ambiguous: the units are messages clustered within slides

gross.sentence: Patients in the heparin group treated with papaverine showed significant improvement in patency (13/17 vs. 3/7, p = .01).
gross.review: clear: 13/17 vs 3/7 printed P = .01; Fisher gives 0.17

gross.sentence: Anopheles funestus was more competent to transmit malaria parasites in the study area, despite relatively lower number tested for sporozoite index (4.14% (63/1521) for An. gambiae vs 8.01% (59/736) for An. funestus; χ 2 = 12.216; P 2 = 0.011; P = 0.9197) and for An. funestus (7.89 vs 8.16%; χ 2 = 2.58 e-29 ; P = 1).
gross.review: ambiguous: two P values are printed in one bracket

gross.sentence: At follow-up, the prevalence of poor sleep quality was lower in the intervention (n=160 of 321, 50%) compared with control (n=184 of 327, 56%) (p=0.04).
gross.review: clear: 160/321 vs 184/327 printed P = 0.04; every 2x2 test gives about 0.11

gross.sentence: Itch reduction was significant among 8/12 (66.7%) subjects completing Week 10 treated with NAL-ER162 vs. placebo (8/20, 40.0%; P = 0.03).
gross.review: clear: 8/12 vs 8/20 printed P = 0.03; every 2x2 test gives over 0.1

gross.sentence: Subepithelial infiltrates developed in 12 of 36 (33%) patients with AdV E4 compared with 98 of 215 (45%) patients with AdV D8 (P = .0001).
gross.review: clear: 12/36 vs 98/215 printed P = .0001; every 2x2 test gives about 0.2

gross.sentence: Body growth and morbidities did not differ, but more cases of periventricular leukomalacia were detected in the infants fed BC (5/155 vs. 0/181, P = 0.06).
gross.review: clear: 5/155 vs 0/181 printed P = 0.06; Fisher gives 0.02

gross.sentence: Adverse events including IPV and termination of the relationship did not vary by arm (IPV: 3/257 index HIVST versus 4/10 PRS; p = 0.57).
gross.review: clear: 3/257 vs 4/10 printed P = 0.57; every 2x2 test gives under 0.001, though 4/10 looks garbled
